title: Path Sum - Solution
intuition: Given the root of a binary tree and an integer targetSum, return true if the tree has a root-to-leaf path such that adding up all the values along the path equals targetSum.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Subtract node value from targetSum and recursively check children. A leaf node must have targetSum == node.val.
